description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named FitDistanceWatchFaceConfigActivity, which manages user interactions for configuring Google Fit integration in a watch face application. It handles connecting to Google Fit APIs, requesting authorization, and enabling or disabling fitness data sharing based on user preferences.

classes.name: FitDistanceWatchFaceConfigActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that allows users to connect or disconnect their Google Fit account to the watch face, managing permissions and API connections.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up UI, loads preferences, and builds GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects GoogleApiClient if fit is enabled.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the authorization activity, updating preferences based on success or cancellation.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Handles suspension of API connection, possibly due to network or service issues.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failure to connect to Google Fit, including attempting to resolve issues.

methods.name: onSwitchClicked
methods.description: Handles user toggling of the fit integration switch, initiating connection or disconnection accordingly.

methods.name: setUserFitPreferences
methods.description: Updates shared preferences and UI switch based on user selection to enable or disable Google Fit integration.
